Olivia (CS): heads up — onboarding SSO handoff failing with 401s for a small set of EU tenants. blocking a few trial activations and one renewal-touch account. need an ETA before i message customers.
Ben (Platform): thanks, investigating identity proxy traces now. can you drop the affected tenant IDs here?
Olivia (CS): pasted tenant ids in ticket #4012. prioritizing the renewal-touch and high-touch trials first.
Harper (AM): confirmed list. i'll prepare exec-ready notes if this stretches beyond 2h.
Kai (SRE): quick check: errors introduced after last identity-proxy deploy (v2.2.0). auth header sometimes missing for sub-request patterns. likely parsing bug.
Ben (Platform): rollback path available. recommend canary rollback to v2.1.3 in eu-west-1, verify auth acceptance, then full rollout. ETA for mitigation ~20-40 minutes.
Olivia (CS): i'll prepare an interim customer status. draft below — please thumbs up or edit.
Olivia (CS): ```Hi — were aware of an authentication error impacting some EU onboarding flows that can prevent activation. Our engineers are investigating and working on a mitigation. We expect restoration within ~30 minutes. If you need immediate help, reply here or join troubleshooting office hours at 16:00 UTC (link). We apologize for the interruption; CS will follow up with next steps and remediation options.```
Tom (Legal): wording ok. avoid promises about credits in the initial note; keep it to conditional offers in follow-up. include support alias.
Kai (SRE): ops can perform manual re-runs for impacted activations as short-term workaround. add that line.
Ben (Platform): executing rollback: `kubectl -n onboarding rollout undo deployment/identity-proxy --to-revision=3`
OpsBot: rollback triggered by ben.platform at 3770012380 for deployment "identity-proxy". link: https://k8s.console/rollouts/identity-proxy
Kai (SRE): canary healthy (2/2). progressing to full rollback. monitoring auth logs and activation queue.
Olivia (CS): sending interim note to affected customers now and opening office hours. scheduling targeted enablement sessions for trials at risk.
Harper (AM): good. recommend 2-week conditional credit for trials if activation failed — i'll coordinate exec outreach for the renewal-touch account.
Tom (Legal): conditional credit language OK: "We will offer a credit if your activation was affected by this incident."
Kai (SRE): rollback complete, auth errors dropped to baseline. root cause: header parsing change in identity-proxy v2.2.0 that dropped authorization for certain multipart requests. follow-ups: revert the change in next release candidate, add integration test for header passthrough, add a deploy-time header check.
Ben (Platform): will open PR for revert and test, and add preflight check for header presence.
Olivia (CS): CS action items: 1) interim sent (done), 2) full RCA + remediation + conditional credit note in 45m, 3) schedule enablement sessions and one-click calendar for affected trials, 4) capture feedback with short survey and flag renewal-risk to AMs.
Harper (AM): i'll start outreach to the renewal-touch account and prep an exec summary if requested.
Kai (SRE): postmortem owners: ben.platform (code + tests), kai.sre (deploy + verification), olivia.cs (customer comms), harper.am (renewal outreach).
Olivia (CS): thanks everyone 44d i'll post the RCA draft here for sign-off shortly.
